en: See these pictures? The legendary Pokémon that made the Unova region. This one's Reshiram...
...and this one's Zekrom. With Pokémon like these, ruling Unova would be easy, right? Too bad we don't have either. Yet.
There's a switch on the wall marked BARRIER. Press it?
Click! From behind the wall came the sound of a barrier switching off.
The switch marked BARRIER is off.
